visualCharacteristics.purpose: Featured games and promotions tile grid
visualCharacteristics.description: White shadowed tiles in a 2-up grid: image with optional overlay strip (jackpot amounts) and corner NEW badge, title, short description, optional next-draw details, full-width pill CTA pinned to the bottom.

contentPattern.structure: cell 1 = image (plus optional text lines shown as an overlay strip on the image); cell 2 = title (heading or first line), description, optional draw details, CTA link as the last link-only paragraph; cell 3 (optional) = badge text such as NEW
contentPattern.description: Repeating look-alike tiles (image, title, description, CTA) that wrap in a grid and each link to a game/detail page.

usage: Featured games/promotions grid, typically in the wide column of a split section next to a rail of promo images.
reuseGuidance: Use for game or product tiles with a CTA each. Image-only promo links belong in a separate block or default content.
